The '''TribBot mimic series''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] product line manufactured by [[RetSpan Audionics]] around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].

TribBots created musical simulations with the voice patterns of [[Melody Fellowship]]'s most popular artists, including [[Gaeriel Capens]]' "[[The Sequential Passage of Chronological Intervals/Legends|The Sequential Passage of Chronological Intervals]]" and her remix of [[Dembaline]]'s "[[Shwock Dubllon]]."
